relationships.subject: allergic airway inflammation
relationships.evidence_quote: more TRPV1 immunoreactive neurons were found in the trigeminal ganglia of OVA-treated mice than in controls

relationships.subject: TRPV1
relationships.evidence_quote: Mechanical hypersensitivity was suppressed in OVA-treated Trpv1-deficient mice

relationships.subject: allergic airway inflammation
relationships.evidence_quote: Trigeminal ganglia of OVA-treated mice displayed larger numbers of activated microglia/macrophages and satellite glia.

key_findings: OVA-induced asthma mice develop facial mechanical hypersensitivity with increased skin nerve fibers and TRPV1 expression in skin and trigeminal ganglion.
Trpv1 deficiency or topical TRPV1 antagonist reduced the hypersensitivity.
